z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Maadaama f(1)=f(2)=4, f(x)−4 waa 0 marka x=1 iyo marka x=2 labadaba. Sidaas darteed waxaa lagu qaybin karaa (x−1)(x−2), f(x)=(x−1)(x−2)·qayb+4, sidaas darteed hadhaagga waa 4.
z-m-22-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Saddexda tibaaxood dhammaantood f(1)=f(2)=4, sidaas darteed haddii aan ka jarno 4, 1 iyo 2 waxay noqdaan xididdo (x−1)(x−2)-na waa qodob ee f(x)−4. Sidaas darteed hadhaagga waa 4.

z-m-22-07.topic: Ku dhufashada polynomial iyo isku-ekaanshaha (is barbar dhigidda isugeynta)

z-m-22-07.material: Isla'eg run ah wax kasta oo aad u geliso x waxaa loo yaqaan isku-ekaansho. Si laba polynomial u noqdaan isla isku-ekaansho, isugeynta xubnaha isla darajada waa inay dhammaantood le'eg yihiin. Hadda aan ka fikirno tirooyinka dhan a, b, c ee ka dhigaya kuwa soo socda isku-ekaansho. (x²+ax+b)(x+c)=x³+2x²−5x−6. Xaqiiqda ah in dhinaca midigta uu le'eg yahay (x+1)(x−2)(x+3) si ujeeddo ah ayaa loo sheegin.

z-m-22-13.prereq.0: H3 ee hawshan waa heerka adkaanta shaqada soo saarka ah oo keliya, ma aha fasal ay maaddo dejisay. U qaado inaad horay u barateen unugga polynomial-ka ee Xisaabta Guud ee dugsiga sare (afarta hawlood ee polynomial-ka, aqoonsiga qaybinta, iyo qodobaynta).

z-m-22-13.topic: Isku-dhufashooyinka tibaax iyo qiimayaasha marka tirooyin la geliyo
z-m-22-13.goal: Habee xiriirrada isku-dhufashooyinka aad ogaan karto iyo kuwa aadan ogaan karin qiimayaasha lagu helay gelinta tirooyin, naftaada samee tibaaxo buuxinaya xiriirka, oo sharax sababta ereyo fudud.
z-m-22-13.material: Haddii aad fidiso f(x)=(2x−1)⁵, erayada laga bilaabo x⁵ ilaa erayga joogtada ah ayaa soo muuqda. U yeedh isku-dhufashada eray kasta c5, c4, c3, c2, c1, c0 (c5 waa isku-dhufashada x⁵ c0 na waa erayga joogtada ah). Hawshan, anagoon fidin, waxaan ka fikirnaa waxa aan ogaan karno iyo waxa aan ogaan karin qiimayaasha lagu helay gelinta 0, 1, −1 oo keliya x. (2x−1)⁵ waxaa loo akhriyaa "2x laga jaray 1, awoodda shanaad".
z-m-22-13.thinking.0: Kala saaridda waxa suurtagal ah iyo waxa suurtagal-la'aan ah
z-m-22-13.s.s1.prompt: U qaad inaad fidisay f(x)=(2x−1)⁵ oo aad qortay f(x)=c5x⁵+c4x⁴+c3x³+c2x²+c1x+c0. Dooro dhammaan waxyaabaha aad heli karto adigoo isticmaalaya qiimayaasha lagu helay gelinta 0, 1, −1 x oo keliya adigoon fidin.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.0: Qor sida qaabka la fidiyey ee f(x) u fududaato marka aad geliso x=0, 1, −1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg erayada kuwa baaba'a marka aad isku darto ama ka jarto natiijooyinka x=1 iyo x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.a: Waxaad aragtay in marka aad geliso x=1, awood kasta oo x ah eray kasta ayaa noqota 1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.b: Saddexda qiime 0, 1, −1, ma kala saari kartid mid ka mid ah lixda isku-dhufasho. Tiri imisa isla'eg ayaad heli kartaa.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.c: Waxaad aragtay in marka aad ka jarto qiimayaasha x=1 iyo x=−1, erayada darajo-laba-laba ay baaba'aan.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.o.d: Wadarka qiimayaasha saxda ah ee isku-dhufashooyinka |c5|+|c4|+|c3|+|c2|+|c1|+|c0|
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.d: Waxaad ku xirtay xaqiiqada ah in calaamadaha isku-dhufashooyinka (2x−1)⁵ ay is beddelaan iyo qiimaha marka x=−1.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.r.e: Kama heli kartid c4 si gooni ah dhowr qiime oo lagu geliyey x. Isbarbar dhig tirada isleegyada aad hesho iyo tirada kuwa aan la aqoon.
z-m-22-13.s.s1.explain: Marka x=1, f(1)=c5+…+c0=(2−1)⁵=1, marka x=−1-na f(−1)=−c5+c4−c3+c2−c1+c0=(−3)⁵=−243. Wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka darajada aan labo-isle'eg ahayn waa (f(1)−f(−1))/2=122. Isku-dhufashooyinku waxay is beddelaan calaamadda (32, −80, 80, −40, 10, −1), sidaas darteed wadarta qiimayaasha saafiga ah waa |f(−1)|=243. c3 ama c4 si gooni ah lama heli karo.

z-m-22-13.s.s2.prompt: Tibaaxda jajab-saddexaad f(x)=x³+ax²+bx+c, samee saddex tibaax oo kala duwan oo wadarta guud ee isku-dhufashooyinku tahay 0 wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka erayada darajada aan labo-isle'eg ahayn (x³, x) na sidoo kale tahay 0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.0: Wadarta guud ee isku-dhufashooyinka iyo wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka erayada darajada aan labo-isle'eg ahayn mid kasta u qor sida isleeg a, b, c ku jira.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore dooro hal xaraf oo hel kuwa kale.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.ok.c2: Wadarta isku-dhufashooyinka erayada darajada aan labo-isle'eg ahayn waa 0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.fail.c2: Wadarta 1+b ee isku-dhufashooyinka erayada darajada aan labo-isle'eg ahayn (x³, x) maaha 0.
z-m-22-13.s.s2.explain: b=−1 iyo c=−a. Tusaalayaal: haddii a=0, x³−x; haddii a=1, x³+x²−x−1; haddii a=2, x³+2x²−x−2. Tibaaxyadani waxay leeyihiin f(1)=0 iyo f(−1)=0, sidaas darteed dhammaantood waxay leeyihiin (x−1)(x+1) sida qodob, x³+ax²−x−a=(x−1)(x+1)(x+a).

z-m-22-13.s.s3.model.1: Haddii aan geliyo x=1, awoodaha oo dhan ee 1 waa 1, sidaas darteed isku-dhufashada oo keliya ayaa ku hadha eray kasta. Tibaaxda la ballaariyey iyo tibaaxda aan la ballaarin waa isla tibaax, sidaas darteed waxaan geliyaa midda ka sahlan, (2x−1)⁵, oo waxaan helayaa 1.

Marka aan eegno natiijooyinka n = 1, 2, 3, ... mid-mid, aan ka fikirno hadhaaga marka n=2026. "x xoogga 2026aad" waa odhaahda x lagu dhuftay 2026 jeer.
